title: Nyeshangte Language (NMM) – L1 & L2 Speakers... | Ethnologue Free
text: Nyeshangte is an endangered indigenous language of Nepal. It belongs to the Sino-Tibetan language family. The language is used as a first language by all adults in the ethnic community, but not all young people.

title: Manang language
text: Manang, also known as Manange, Nyeshang, or Nyeshangte, is a Sino-Tibetan language belonging to the Tibeto-Burman branch and specifically the Tamangic (TGTM) subgroup of the Bodish languages.
